title: nf-core/pathogensurveillance pipeline - params.reference_data schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.reference_data

ref_ncbi_query_max.errorMessage: The `ref_ncbi_query_max` column must be a whole number, optionally followed by a '%' to indicate a percentage of results (e.g. '25' or '25%'). Leave blank to use the default.

ref_primary_usage.errorMessage: The `ref_primary_usage` column must be one of 'optional', 'required', 'excluded', or 'exclusive'. Leave blank to use the default.

ref_contextual_usage.errorMessage: The `ref_contextual_usage` column must be one of 'optional', 'required', 'excluded', or 'exclusive'. Leave blank to use the default.

ref_enabled.errorMessage: The `ref_enabled` column must be either 'TRUE' or 'FALSE'. Leave blank to use the default.
